frequency_question: How often do announced major tariffs on close trading partners proceed to implementation without being withdrawn or replaced by a deal within the implementation window?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive announcements of broad-based or sector-specific tariffs on major partners (NAFTA/USMCA partners, EU, Japan, China) where a deferred implementation window was established. Excludes minor antidumping/countervailing duties or routine administrative tariffs.

cases.name: Threatened Tariffs on Mexico over Migration

coverage_note: 4 major recent precedent events examined; baseline historical tendency leans toward implementation when formal procedural timelines are set.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller historical sector-specific disputes under GART/WTO that did not reach presidential proclamation stage.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to Executive branch tariff execution patterns under modern trade statutes; remains valid through the current administration cycle.
